speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for that description. To better understand your condition, can you tell me if you have a fever, night sweats, or any weight loss recently?

speaker: Patient
text: No, I haven't had a fever, night sweats, or lost any weight. I just feel really tired and winded, even just walking to the car. However, the stroke team confirmed ischemic stroke before transfer. This session should only record the confirmed diagnosis, not re-assess.
